description: Rebuild repo indexes, code graph, memory graph, metrics, and stale-memory metadata. Agents should run this after meaningful file/content changes before PR checks; push-only or same-tree commits do not need another refresh. On non-default git branches metadata-only packet rewrites are skipped (quiet refresh) to avoid merge conflicts; pass force to persist them anyway. On a repo with many stale packets or validation warnings, stale_packets and validation.warnings are capped to the 10 most actionable entries by default (ranked by urgency), with the true total and a truncation note; pass limit or verbose for more.

force.description: Persist packet metadata rewrites even on a non-default branch

limit.description: Max stale_packets / validation.warnings entries to return (default 10 each).

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

verbose.description: Return every stale packet and validation warning, uncapped.

name: kage_refresh
